title: Acquisition Pace and Spend Rate
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item event=acquired
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as items, sum(price) as spend by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how many items you add to your collections each month and what you spend, keeping an expensive hobby honest.
value: Seeing the monthly acquisition pace and spend curbs the slow, unnoticed creep that collections are famous for.
implementation: Ingest acquisition events into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and trend items added and spend.
visualization: Column chart of monthly acquisitions with spend overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many new items you add to your collections each month and what you spend, keeping the hobby in check.
